When the zone stack is full (CWIKI_ZONE_MAX_DEPTH = 16), an opening brace-group is not pushed, but its closing brace still pops a zone. Brace groups alone can now reach this limit. A probe with 17 nested braces in `$\ce{...} y$ and $w$ tail` produced one compilable inline block that ran to the end o

tex_block measures depth by counting opening spans, not by reading the zone stack. When the zone engine drops a push at the depth limit, the count and the stack disagree. The block then ends through the 'stack emptied without a close span' fallback at the end of the line and takes in unrelated trail

tex_package_name checks note `packages:` entries against the allowed character set only, without string_scalar(). As a result, `packages: [null]`, `[true]` and `[1.0]` are accepted as package names, and tagged nodes are not rejected. `preamble:` uses the stricter string check, so R2.8.5 is applied u
